Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished, accurate Simplified Chinese infographic for the README of an actual developer project named Praxis Harness. Landscape canvas, approximately 1800x1200, 3:2 aspect ratio. This is one of a coordinated set of three. Crisp professional Chinese sans serif typography, large readable text, navy #14233B headings, cobalt #315BEE primary, pale blue #EBF1FF panels, white background, restrained teal #1D9B91 success accents and small amber exception accents. Elegant technical editorial layout, generous spacing, consistent thin outline icons, very subtle dimensional illustrations, flat clear text panels with precise typography. Sophisticated and approachable, not a game poster. Every arrow and every Chinese label must be legible and correct. Keep all text fully inside safe margins. No extra English marketing slogans, invented capability, invented metric, fake screenshot text, watermark or decorative serial numbers. Use the exact specified texts.
Asset 1, project introduction. Heading at upper left "Praxis Harness", subtitle "可执行、可验收的本地 AI 工作台".
Below header a balanced three-part layout. LEFT a clean panel titled "可以完成哪些工作" with four generously separated icon-and-label rows, each with a short explanatory line:
"理解项目" / "阅读代码与文件，梳理结构"
"开发与修复" / "修改代码、排查问题、执行命令"
"资料与分析" / "检索资料、分析日志、生成报告"
"验证结果" / "检查产物与测试，查看修复过程"
CENTER a tasteful large semi-isometric illustration of a desktop browser workstation, local folder and code document, using white and pale blue surfaces, cobalt outlines, soft minimal depth. The browser is an illustration, not a supposed real screenshot. Render only these few words inside it: "任务", "分析", "工具执行", "验收报告". Small connected file and terminal symbols communicate work on actual local files. Beneath illustration the short label "围绕你的本地项目协作".
RIGHT a three-level vertical explanation titled "通过什么工作", connected by small clear downward arrows:
"大模型" / "理解目标，分析与规划"
"Agent Runtime" / "组织上下文，调用工具"
"Harness" / "按条件验收，在限制内修复"
At bottom, a full-width subtle blue band has three evenly spaced feature groups with icons:
"项目长期记忆" / "用户确认保存，跨会话检索经验"
"过程可追溯" / "查看工具记录、验收轮次与来源"
"执行有边界" / "工作区权限、审批与 Windows 沙箱"
One short footer text in dark slate: "应用与数据保存在本机，模型按配置连接本地或远程服务。"
Do not show human avatars, logos of other products, success rates, automated self-learning claims, or cloud deployment. The main visual should be the workstation illustration, information hierarchy is bold product title → three explanatory areas → capabilities. Make the text comfortably readable at README width.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished, accurate Simplified Chinese infographic for the README of an actual developer project named Praxis Harness. Landscape canvas, approximately 1800x1200, 3:2 aspect ratio. This is one of a coordinated set of three. Crisp professional Chinese sans serif typography, large readable text, navy #14233B headings, cobalt #315BEE primary, pale blue #EBF1FF panels, white background, restrained teal #1D9B91 success accents and small amber exception accents. Elegant technical editorial layout, generous spacing, consistent thin outline icons, very subtle dimensional illustrations, flat clear text panels with precise typography. Sophisticated and approachable, not a game poster. Every arrow and every Chinese label must be legible and correct. Keep all text fully inside safe margins. No extra English marketing slogans, invented capability, invented metric, fake screenshot text, watermark or decorative serial numbers. Use the exact specified texts.
Asset 2, overall task workflow. The top header repeats the exact same visual identity as companion artwork: big bold navy "Praxis Harness" at upper left, slim vertical blue rounded accent to its left; subtitle "从任务到可追溯的验收结果". This is a readable software workflow diagram with a structured repair loop, not a decorative network.
Lay out the upper main sequence as SIX evenly spaced pale-blue rounded cards in one straight horizontal line across the page, with cobalt arrows left to right. Each has a clean blue line icon above text:
1 "定义目标" / "绑定项目 · 配置验收"
2 "加载上下文" / "文件 · 项目经验"
3 "分析与规划" / "理解约束 · 拆分任务"
4 "工具执行" / "权限检查 · 调用工具"
5 "结构化验收" / "按配置检查产物"
6 "交付结果" / "产物 · 报告 · Trace"
Arrow from 5 to 6 is teal and explicitly labeled "通过". Above or inside the main lane put the small caption "配置 Harness 验收后的任务流程". Do not add other steps to this row.
Under the main sequence, a medium pale-blue rounded card under cards 3–5 titled "失败反馈与修复分析", body "汇总失败条件与工具证据". A cobalt arrow LEAVES the bottom of card 5, labeled "失败且有剩余额度", bends toward this feedback card. An arrow LEAVES the feedback card, goes LEFT then UP, and has its arrowhead clearly entering the bottom of card 3 "分析与规划". This direction must be visually unambiguous: acceptance -> feedback -> analysis -> tools -> acceptance. Under that feedback card write "修复次数、模型轮数与工具调用均有上限".
A separate small amber stop card at middle right below card 6, titled "停止并记录原因", body in two lines "阻塞 · 检查超时 · 用户取消" / "调用或修复额度耗尽". Add a short amber branch from the execution/acceptance region to this stop card with label "无法继续".
The bottom third is an independent pale blue lane titled "把已验证的修复留给下一次任务". Its clearly spaced chain reads
"同一条件失败后复验通过" -> "用户确认保存" -> "本地项目经验".
Include a tasteful small SQLite-style database cylinder icon next to "本地项目经验". A clearly separated DASHED teal arrow from that final memory node routes along the left edge upward to card 2 "加载上下文", labeled "同项目新会话检索". Do NOT draw an automatic save arrow directly from task success to memory. User confirmation must be visible.
Footer text "经验保留适用条件、建议做法与验收来源，新任务仍需重新验证。"
Use meticulously routed orthogonal connectors, visible arrowheads, no crossing any text or boxes, plenty of space. No dotted decorative lines besides the meaningful future-retrieval connection. Accurate Chinese text is essential; do not omit the feedback return to analysis, the resource stop path, or the explicit user confirmation. No decorative numerals.

Landscape canvas, approximately 1800x1200, 3:2 aspect ratio. This is one of a coordinated set of three. Asset 3, technology stack and local deployment. Match the companion Praxis Harness overview with the same white/offwhite background, blue rounded panels, navy typography, small teal accents and crisp blue outline icons. Top left brand header "Praxis Harness" with slim blue rounded accent bar. Subtitle "技术栈与 Windows 本地部署".
Upper half is a clear architecture composition with a horizontal row of three substantial panels:
LEFT "前端工作台", a browser icon, and lines "React 18 · TypeScript 5", "Vite 5 · Ant Design 6", small description "对话 · 验收 · 评测 · 记忆".
CENTER "本地后端", a clean layered server icon and lines "Python 3.11+", "FastAPI · Uvicorn", "Agent Runtime · Harness".
RIGHT "本地存储", a database icon and lines "SQLite · FTS5 · TOML", small descriptions "会话与项目" and "经验与验收来源".
Connect frontend and backend with two directional arrows labeled "HTTP / SSE", connect backend and storage with two directional arrows. Under the backend, one slim connected horizontal panel titled "模型与工具" with three balanced text groups "模型 Provider" / "Skills · MCP" / "Windows Sandbox Broker". Do not represent a cloud account system or PostgreSQL.
Separate the bottom half with generous white space and a subheading "本地部署流程". Directly beneath, prerequisite line "准备环境  Windows · Python 3.11+ · Node.js 22 · uv".
Then a left-to-right row of FOUR step cards with small icons and explicit meaningful step numbers 1–4:
Card 1 title "安装后端依赖", small location "仓库根目录", code line EXACTLY "uv sync --locked".
Card 2 title "安装并构建前端", small location "frontend 目录", two code lines EXACTLY "npm ci" and "npm run build".
Card 3 title "启动本地后端", small location "返回仓库根目录", code line EXACTLY "uv run python -m backend.api".
Card 4 title "打开工作台", address EXACTLY "http://127.0.0.1:8000", small note "配置模型服务与 API Key".
At bottom a wide pale-blue panel with small shield icon and title "首次使用沙箱", text "在设置中安装或启动 Broker，按提示完成管理员授权；状态就绪后执行受隔离命令。". Use a full stop instead of the Chinese semicolon in that sentence: actual desired text is "在设置中安装或启动 Broker，按提示完成管理员授权。状态就绪后执行受隔离命令。"
Footer "生产模式由后端托管前端页面。模型可按配置连接本地或远程服务。"
All commands and addresses must be perfectly spelled, aligned, and readable. Prioritize readable text over decorative flourishes. Keep 4 deployment cards wide enough for the longest command; it may have a gentle deliberate line break in a visually contained code box but must preserve all tokens. Do not invent extra prerequisites, cloud deployment, Docker requirements, or service-install shell commands.
